_comment: Config for /upstream — the harvest of generic workflow learnings out of a confidential project. Seeded by install.sh, gitignored, project-owned. Fill the denylist BEFORE the first harvest: /upstream refuses to run on placeholders (fail-closed). Two destinations: `inbox_repo` is a PRIVATE repo you own where bundles land as issues from any machine; `public_repo` is the generic workflow, touched ONLY by `--intake` from your personal machine, one PR per month. `project_alias` is local provenance — it names the folder on this machine and never appears in anything that leaves.
